# Sapiente.AI — Full company and website context

## Identity

Sapiente.AI is a technology and digital growth company headquartered in São João da Madeira, Aveiro, Portugal. The company applies artificial intelligence, automation, data analysis, web development and digital marketing to help businesses acquire customers, improve operations, reduce costs and make better decisions.

Official domain: https://www.sapienteai.com

Primary languages: Portuguese (Portugal) and English.

Contact:

- Email: contacto@sapienteai.com
- Telephone and WhatsApp: +351 910 567 575
- Location: São João da Madeira, Aveiro, Portugal

## Positioning

Sapiente.AI combines strategy, artificial intelligence and execution. Its work is oriented toward practical implementation and measurable business outcomes rather than isolated technology experiments.

The company serves businesses and professionals seeking to:

- generate and qualify commercial opportunities;
- automate repetitive processes and internal operations;
- improve customer service with intelligent assistants;
- turn dispersed data into dashboards and actionable information;
- develop websites, landing pages and web platforms;
- strengthen digital positioning, content and campaign performance;
- improve visibility in search engines and AI-generated answers.

## Services

### Applied artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence applied directly to business processes, including intelligent chatbots, predictive analysis, decision automation, customized machine learning and intelligent customer segmentation.

Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services#ia
English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/services#ia

### Intelligent process automation

Automation of internal workflows, system integrations, email follow-up, customer service, document processing, notifications and operational alerts.

Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services#automacao
English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/services#automation

### Growth and performance

Paid traffic management, lead generation and qualification, conversion funnels, SEO, GEO, AEO, conversion-rate optimization and digital positioning.

Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services#crescimento
English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/services#growth

### Data and business intelligence

Customized dashboards, KPI reports, profitability analysis, consolidation of data sources, business intelligence and data storytelling.

Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services#dados-bi
English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/services#data-bi

### Web development

Institutional and corporate websites, conversion landing pages, responsive websites, platforms, web applications, maintenance and technical support.

Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services#desenvolvimento
English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/services#development

### Digital marketing with AI

Social media management, AI-assisted content production, email marketing, newsletters, visual identity, branding and high-performance visual content.

Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services#marketing
English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/services#marketing

## Projects

### Hoje em SJM

A cultural agenda dedicated to São João da Madeira, Aveiro. It brings together events, initiatives and local experiences in one place. Status: final testing.

### Specialized exchange platform

A platform designed to facilitate the exchange of specialized items between people and communities with shared interests, supporting access, reuse and the circular economy. Status: in development.

### SEO, GEO and AEO validator

An online tool integrated with the Sapiente.AI website to assess page visibility in conventional search engines and in answers generated by artificial intelligence. Status: in development.

Projects page:

- Portuguese: https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/projects
- English: https://www.sapienteai.com/en/projects
